records.excerpt: PURCHASE, SALE OR REDEMPTION OF THE COMPANY’S LISTED SECURITIES During the year ended 31 December 2019, the Company repurchased 3,486,700 shares on the Stock Exchange for an aggregate consideration of approximately HKD1.16 billion before expenses. The repurchased shares were subsequently cancelled. The repurchase was effected by the Board for the enhancement of shareholder value in the long term.
